observation: Front: the disc wall widens as it rises, which is the Sol draft, and the top edge is rounded while the bed edge is left sharp so the piece stands flat. Saturn additionally carries its ring: the ring plate leans at the planet's obliquity, meets the globe along its inner edge, and the web under its low side runs down to the disc so no part of the ring's underside is left unsupported. The ring is clear of the disc's outer edge on every side. Top: disc, seat collar and globe are concentric on one axis. Iso: one ball on one disc through a short seat collar, no step and no gap at the joint. The outer surface is unbroken everywhere -- every marking in this set is a flush colour inlay, so none is visible on this fused printed solid and none should be. No protrusion, no floating body, no missing or extra part, no visible intersection, and no downward-facing surface added.
